newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar hardly stirs in absence of NY.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar hardly stirs in absence of NY.

text.p: London's white sugar futures market barely stirred into life on Friday with little activity expected for the remainder of the day due to the absence of the New York market.
Spot August was the only contract traded but the vast bulk of this was an against actuals trade, coupled with a small commission house sale.
At 1120 GMT August stood 40 cents lower at $319.50 in a total volume of 280 lots.
"There's nothing going on," said one trader. The New York raw sugar market is closed on Friday on account of the July 4 Independence Day holiday.

Technically, analysts said there could be another test of uptrend support if August were to move much below $320. Support has been pegged at around $315.50, at the upward trendline extending from January's low of $295.00.
